question_text: What can red-white warning plates on vehicles indicate?

options.text: A trailer parked on the roadway within a built-up area

correct_answers.text: A trailer parked on the roadway within a built-up area

comment: Red and white warning signs point to vehicles with excess width (e.g., abnormal wide agricultural vehicles). Trailers parked inside a built-up area must either be illuminated or marked with reflective warning signs. So, warning signs do not refer to hazmat trucks.
